content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD misc.F: six utility subroutines. INDEX (L54-178) builds the MPI domain decomposition: allocates ProcessorID(PX,PY) (L67), sets dims/periods/coords (L69-80), aborts via MPI_FINALIZE if nprocs /= Px*Py (L83-90), creates a 2D Cartesian communicator comm2d with MPI_CART_CREATE (L93-94), gets npx/npy from MPI_CART_COORDS (L95-98), neighbor ranks n_west/n_east/n_suth/n_nrth via MPI_Cart_shift (L100-101), fills ProcessorID and myidi/myidj (L103-114); per-processor index ranges iista..iiend/jjsta..jjend come from grid_range_per_procs (L132-133), local sizes Mloc/Nloc = range + 2*Nghost (L135-136, serial: L162-163), rank-0 writes all ranges to Grid_Range.out (L149-157), then Mloc1/Nloc1/Ibeg/Iend/Iend1/Jbeg/Jend/Jend1 are set (L168-176). grid_range_per_procs (L181-204) splits n1..n2 across nprocs: inum1=int((n2-n1+1)/nprocs), inum2=mod remainder (L197-198), stag/endg with remainder spread to low ranks (L200-203). ESTIMATE_DT (L216-296) computes CFL time step: for each cell TMP1=|U|+sqrt(GRAV*max(H,MinDepthFrc)) (L243, y: L259), TMP2=DX/TMP1 (guard TMP1<SMALL -> DX/SMALL, L244-256; CARTESIAN scalar vs curvilinear DX(I,J) via preprocessor), TMP3=global min over both directions, MPI_ALLREDUCE MIN under PARALLEL (L277-279), DT_tmp=CFL*TMP3 (L281); if FIXED_DT, DT starts at DT_fixed and is halved until DT<=DT_tmp (L283-291), else DT=DT_tmp; TIME=TIME+DT (L294). MAX_MIN_PROPERTY (L307-383, header cites Chen et al., 2004 at L300-301) accumulates per-cell running extrema when MASK>0: HeightMax from Eta if OUT_Hmax (or WindForce under METEO, L317-325), HeightMin if OUT_Hmin (L327-331), VelocityMax from sqrt(U^2+V^2) if OUT_Umax (L333-338), MomentumFluxMax from (U^2+V^2)*H if OUT_MFmax (L340-345), first arrival time ARRTIME=TIME when |Eta|>ArrTimeMin and ARRTIME==0 if OUT_Time (L347-354); if OUT_VORmax on non-CARTESIAN builds it computes Vx,Uy by DERIVATIVE_X/DERIVATIVE_Y (L363-364) and VorticityMax from |Vx-Uy| (L365-372); under PARALLEL VorticityMax ghost cells are exchanged with phi_exch (L376-380). CHECK_BLOWUP (L394-433) computes MaxAbsEta=MAXVAL(abs(Eta(interior))) (L403), MPI_ALLREDUCE MAX (L405); if MaxAbsEta>EtaBlowVal it prints blowup time (L413-415), sets ICOUNT=99998, calls PREVIEW to dump output (L419-420), then MPI_ABORT (PARALLEL, L425; switched from MPI_FINALIZE per comment L423-424) or STOP (L427). wall_time_secs (L443-476) converts date_and_time values (L449) to seconds tcurrent using month-length mscale=31/30/29/28 chosen at L459-470 (leap test years divisible by 4, L466) and formula L472-473. SHAPIRO_3 (L479-533, compiled only under FILTERING, L478) applies a 7-point Shapiro smoothing filter with coefficients a1=44/64, a2=15/64, a3=-6/64, a4=1/64 (comments L482-485) in x then y; masked neighbors are replaced by center value p0 via VAR*MASK+(1-MASK)*p0 (L499-504, L519-524); x pass writes VAR (L506), y pass writes back VAR_IN_OUT (L526).
entities: iistas, iiends, jjstas, jjends ALLOCATABLE INTEGER arrays (L61)
DX,DY INTENT(IN) scalar CARTESIAN (L229) or DIMENSION(M,N) (L231)

unresolved: CHECK_BLOWUP header comment says threshold was changed to 100*max_depth (L391) but the code compares against EtaBlowVal from GLOBAL (L409); where EtaBlowVal is set to 100*max depth is not in this file.
ESTIMATE_DT uses TMP1/TMP2/TMP3, LARGE, SMALL, GRAV, MPI_SP without local declaration (L239-281) - they come from USE PARAM/GLOBAL (L217-220), definitions external to this file.

INDEX under PARALLEL uses iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend (L132-136) which are not declared locally - assumed from GLOBAL; myidi/myidj are set only inside the myid==icp match (L108-110) before use at L132-133.

wall_time_secs approximates elapsed seconds by months*mscale where mscale is the length of a single month chosen by the current month (L459-470, formula L472-473), and the leap test is only years divisible by 4 (L466) - approximate by construction.

SHAPIRO_3 cross-line issue: the x pass assigns VAR only for I in 1+Nghost..M-Nghost and MASK==1 (L495-506), but the y pass reads VAR(I,J) and VAR(I,J+-k) for all I=1,M and MASK(I,J)==1 (L515-524) - VAR at ghost columns I<=Nghost or I>M-Nghost, and at cells whose neighbors were masked in x, is read uninitialized.
MAX_MIN_PROPERTY declares MaxAbsEta (L313) but never uses it in this subroutine (L307-383).
